verses.text: Haxo winhaj Saulo, max yaktej winh yalani to ol smilcham heb' tz'ak'anoch Jesús Kajal t'a sk'o'ol. Yuj chi' ix k'och winh t'a winh sat sacerdote.

Ix sk'anan juntzanh ch'anh carta winh, yik syik'anb'at ch'anh winh t'a yoltak spatil culto ay t'a chonhab' Damasco. Ha juntzanh carta chi' tz'ak'an sderecho winh yik syaman jantaknhej heb' syak'och spensar t'a Jesús, wach'chom winak ma ix, yik syik'kot heb' winh preso t'a Jerusalén.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winh, palta haxo yik wan sk'och winh t'a slak'anil chonhab' Damasco chi', ix emul kopnaj jun sakil k'inal t'a satcha'anh t'a yib'anh winh.
Yuj chi' ix telwi winh t'a sat lu'um. Ix yab'an winh yoch jun lolonel. Ix yalan icha tik: --Saulo, Saulo, ¿tas yuj tzin ixtej? xchi t'a winh.
--Mamin, ¿mach ach? xchi winh. --Ha in ton tik Jesús in. Ha in wal tzin ixtej.
--K'e'anh wa'an, ixik t'a chonhab' chi'. Hata' ol alchaj t'ayach tas yowalil ol a k'ulej, xchi Jesús chi' t'a winh.
Haxo heb' winh yetb'eyum winhaj Saulo chi', ix wanaj heb' winh, ix sat sk'ol heb' winh yuj xiwelal. Ix yab' heb' winh to ay mach sloloni, palta malaj mach ix yil heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e wa'an winhaj Saulo chi' t'a sat lu'um. Haxo yik ix elta k'elan winh, majxo yal-laj yilan jab'ok winh. Yuj chi' a heb' winh yetb'eyum winh ix yaman sk'ab', ix sketzanb'at winh heb' winh t'a yol chonhab' Damasco chi'.
Haxo ix k'och winh ta', oxe' k'uhal majxo yal-laj yilan winh. Majxo walaj winh. Majxo yuk'paxlaj ha' winh.
Ha t'a Damasco chi' ay jun winh creyente skuchan Ananías, haxo Jesús Kajal ix halan t'a winh icha t'a wayichal icha tik: --Ach Ananías, xchi. --Tik ay in Mamin, xchi winh.
--Ixik t'a jun calle skuch Tojol. Ayik tzach k'och t'a spat winhaj Judas, tza k'anb'an t'a winh yuj winhaj Saulo aj Tarso. Ol hilani to wan slesalwi winh.
Ay jun tas ix in ch'ox t'a winh. Ix yilan winh to a ach ol ach k'ochok, ol ak'anek' a k'ab' t'a sjolom winh, yik wach' ol jakwokxikan sat winh, xchi Jesús Kajal chi' t'a winh.
Palta haxo ix yalan winh: --Mamin, tzijtum mach ix halan t'ayin yuj winhaj Saulo chi'. Ha t'a Jerusalén manh jantakok chukal ix yak' winh t'a heb' tzach ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol.
Xal tiknaik ix ja winh t'a tik, yik syamji jantaknhej heb' syal sb'a t'ayach yuj winh, yujto ak'b'il yopisio winh yuj heb' winh sat sacerdote, xchi winh.

Palta ix yalanxi Jesús Kajal chi' t'a winh: --Ixik, yujto a winhaj Saulo chi', ix in sik'el winh, yik wach' ol yalel in lolonel winh t'a skal heb' manh israelok, t'a yichanh heb' rey yet' t'a skal heb' eyetisraelal.
Ha in ol in ch'ox t'a winh, jantak sya'elal yowalil ol yab' winh wu'uj, xchi Jesús Kajal chi'.

Yuj chi', ix b'at winhaj Ananías chi' t'a jun pat chi'. Haxo ix k'och winh, ix och winh t'a yo'ol. Ix yak'anek' sk'ab' winh t'a sjolom winhaj Saulo chi'. Ix yalan winh: --Wuk'tak Saulo, a Kajal Jesús, jun ix sch'ox sb'a t'ayach t'a yol b'e b'aj ach jawi chi', ha' in chekankot t'ayach, yik wach' ol jakwokxi a sat, haxo yochkan Espíritu Santo t'ayach, xchi winh t'a winh.
Junanto rato chi' ix elta tziknaj juntzanh icha stumin nok' chay ayoch t'a yol sat winh, ichato chi' ix b'oxikan yilan winh. Ix k'e wa'an winh, ix yak'an ak'jok bautizar sb'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix wa winh, ix yik'anxi yip winh. Ix aj jaye' k'uhal winh yet' heb' creyente t'a Damasco chi'.
Ha winhaj Saulo chi', ix syamoch winh yalel slolonel Dios t'a yoltak spatil culto. Ix yalan winh to a Jesús, Yuninal ton Dios.

Jantaknhej heb' ix ab'an yalan winh, ix te sat sk'o'ol heb'. Ix yalan heb': --Haton jun winh tik ix ak'anoch sya'elal heb' syal sb'a t'a Jesús t'a Jerusalén. Ha ko na'ani to sja winh ul syam heb' creyente t'a tik, yik syik'b'at heb' winh t'a heb' winh sat sacerdote, xchi heb'.

Haxo winhaj Saulo chi', ix ste ak'ej yip winh yalaneli, yik wach' scheklajeli to a Jesús t'a wal yel Cristo toni, haton jun tanhwab'il yuj heb'. Haxo heb' israel aj Damasco chi', maj nachajel jab'ok yuj heb' tas syutej heb' spakan t'a winh.
Ayik niwanxo tiempo ix ek'i, ix slajtian sb'a heb' israel t'a spatik winhaj Saulo chi'. Ix yalan heb' to ol smilcham winh heb'.
Palta ix yab' spekal winh to k'uhal t'ak'wal stanhwan heb' t'a juntzanh b'e sb'at t'a stiel chonhab', yik hata' smilcham winh heb' sna'ani.
Yuj chi', a heb' creyente ix ak'anem winh t'a yol jun xu'uk, haxo t'a swentenail smuroal jun chonhab' chi' ix yak'em t'unhunhok winh heb' t'ak'walil. Icha chi' ix aj skolchajel winh.
Haxo yik ix k'och winhaj Saulo chi' t'a Jerusalén, ix snib'ej winh smolb'ej sb'a yet' heb' creyente ta', palta tonhej ix xiwk'e heb' smasanil t'a winh. Maj schalaj yab' heb' tato yel creyentexo winh.

Palta a jun winh skuch Bernabé ix ik'anb'at winh t'a heb' winh schekab' Jesús. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Ha winhaj Saulo tik, ix yil Kajal Jesús winh t'a yol b'e. Ix lolonpax Kajal Jesús chi' yet' winh. Yuj chi' malaj mach b'aj ix xiw winh yalanel yab'ixal Jesús t'a chonhab' Damasco chi', xchi winhaj Bernabé chi'.
Yuj chi' ix aj winhaj Saulo t'a Jerusalén chi'. Junnhej ix ek' winh yet' heb' creyente ta'.
Ix ste tek'b'an sb'a winh yalanel yab'ixal Kajal Jesús. Ix stelan sb'a winh yet' heb' yetisraelal tz'alan sti' heb' griego. Palta a heb' chi', ix slajtiej sb'a heb' yik smilancham winh heb'.
Haxo ix yab'an spekal jun chi' heb' creyente, ix yik'anb'at winhaj Saulo chi' heb' t'a chonhab' Cesarea. Ixlajwi sk'och heb' yet' winh ta', ix schekankanb'at winh heb' t'a chonhab' Tarso.

Ichato chi', ix och wa'an spechji b'eyek' heb' creyente t'a masanil chonhab' t'a yol yik Judea, t'a yol yik Galilea yet' t'a yol yik Samaria. Ix laj stek'b'itan sb'a heb'. Te na'annhej Kajal Jesús yuj heb'. Ix och Yespíritu Dios yet' heb', yuj chi' ix te k'ib' sb'isul heb'.
Ha junel, ayik ix ek' winhaj Pedro yil heb' yetcreyenteal, ix k'och winh t'a heb' creyente t'a chonhab' Lida.
Hata' ix ilchaj jun winh skuch Eneas yuj winh. Swajxakilxo ab'il stelwikan winh, yujto sikb'inakel winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh: --Ach Eneas, swal t'ayach, a Jesucristo tz'ak'an b'oxok a k'o'ol. Yuj chi' k'e'anh wa'an, pak a waynub' tik, xchi winh t'a winh. Wal t'a jun rato chi', ix k'e wan winh.
Haxo heb' anima smasanil aj Lida chi' yet' heb' aj Sarón, ix yil heb' to ix b'oxikan winh. Yuj chi' ix sk'ex sb'eyb'al heb', ix yak'anoch spensar heb' t'a Kajal Jesús.
Ha t'a chonhab' Jope, ay jun ix creyente skuchan Tabita. Haxo t'a ti' griego Dorcas sb'i ix. Te wach' ix, skolwaj ix t'a heb' meb'a'.
Haxo t'a jun tiempo chi', ix yamchaj ix yuj jun yab'il, ix cham ix. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'ikchajel sniwanil ix, ix ik'jik'e t'a yol jun cuarto t'a cha'anh.

Ha jun chonhab' Jope chi', ha t'a slak'anil chonhab' Lida ay, haton b'aj ayek' winhaj Pedro chi'. Haxo ix yab'an heb' creyente to hata' ayek' winh, ix schekanb'at chawanh winak heb' t'a winh, ix yalan heb' winh: --Kotanh, konh ket'ok t'a Jope wal tiknaik, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Pedro chi' yet' heb' winh. Haxo ix k'och winh, ix ik'jik'e winh t'a jun cuarto b'aj ay sniwanil ix Dorcas chi'. Hata' molanek' heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum. Wan yok' heb' ix yuj ix. Ay juntzanh spichul heb' ix yet' juntzanh skamix sb'onak ix Dorcas chi' ayik pitzanto ix. Ix sch'oxan juntzanh chi' heb' ix t'a winhaj Pedro chi'.

Haxo winh ix chekanxiemta heb' smasanil. Ixlajwi chi' ix em kuman winh, ix lesalwi winh. Ix och k'elan winh t'a ix Dorcas chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a ix: --Ach Tabita, swal t'ayach, k'e'anh wa'an, xchi winh t'a ix. Haxo ix elta k'elan ix. Ix yilanoch winhaj Pedro chi' ix, ix k'e k'ojan ix.
Ha winh ix yaman sk'ab' ix. Ix sketzank'e wa'an ix winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtanxik'e heb' ix ix chi' winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' creyente. Ix sch'oxanelta ix winh t'a heb' to ix pitzwixi ix.
Haxo heb' aj Jope chi', ix laj yab' spekal jun chi' heb'. Yuj chi' tzijtum heb' ix ak'anoch Kajal Jesús t'a sk'o'ol.
Ha winhaj Pedro chi', ixto ek' jayexo k'uhal winh t'a Jope chi', haxo t'a spat jun winh skuchan Simón smunlaj yet' nok' tz'um ix aj winh.
